```rust
use serde_json::Value;

pub fn solve(input: serde_json::Value) -> serde_json::Value {
    let mut sum_diagonal = 0;
    let mut sum_anti_diagonal = 0;
    let mut n = input.as_array().unwrap().len() as i64;

    for i in 0..n {
        for j in 0..n {
            if i == j {
                sum_diagonal += input[i as usize][j as usize];
            } else if i == n - 1 - j {
                sum_anti_diagonal += input[i as usize][j as usize];
            }
        }
    }

    serde_json::Value::Object(vec![
        (String::from("sum_diagonal"), serde_json::Value::Number(sum_diagonal)),
        (String::from("sum_anti_diagonal"), serde_json::Value::Number(sum_anti_diagonal)),
    ])
}

fn main() {
    let input = serde_json::Value::from("[[1,2],[3,4]]");
    let expected = serde_json::Value::from("[5,5]");
    assert_eq!(solve(input), expected);
}
```
